questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the road will curve right and then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited at this location.

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only move in the direction the arrow points.

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are heading the wrong way on a one-way street and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, hand signals help communicate between riders. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, it signals the group to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is ahead. You should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed to drive when exiting a highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must obey them. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you to be careful when the road is wet. Your vehicle may be harder to control on wet pavement.

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is now divided by a median or divider. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. Always slow down when conditions are not ideal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic signal, red is always at the top and green at the bottom. On a horizontal signal, red is always on the left and green on the right.
